player_0.content: New plan: I got stuck in an infinite loop between the Closet, Cellar, and Exercise room, repeatedly traversing the same edges without ever exploring the other available directions (like east from the Cellar or north from the Sunroom). My strategy failed because I blindly followed the first available direction without tracking visited rooms or unexplored paths. Next time, I will maintain a mental map of visited rooms and untried directions. Upon entering a room, I will explicitly check if all adjacent directions have been tried; if a new direction exists, I will take it immediately. Only when all directions from the current room have been exhausted will I backtrack to the previous room to explore its remaining paths, ensuring every room is visited before declaring "DONE".
